visitUuid.description:
| | |
|----|----|
|**Length**| an..32 |
|**Occurrence**| 1..1 |
|**Description**| Universal Unique Identifier for the Visit as generated by the PCS |
|**Validation**|R191 - V-Valid Visit UUID |

equipmentNumber.description:
| | |
|----|----|
|**Length**| an..11 |
|**Occurrence**| 0..1 |
|**Cardinality**| Conditional |
|**Format**| 'AAAA9999999' |
|**Description**| Equipment number|
|**Validation**| R040 - C-Loading on size type |
||R037 - V-If not shippers owned format must be correct |
||R043 - V-for POST duplicate check |
||R088 - V-for PUT duplicate check |
||R089 - V-for PUT equipment number allowed |

shippersOwnedContainer.description:
| | |
|----|----|
|**Length**| an..5 |
|**Occurrence**| 0..1 |
|**Description**| Shippers owned indicator. Default = False. True bypasses the equipment number validation. |

full.description:
| | |
|----|----|
|**Length**| an..5 |
|**Occurrence**| 1..1 |
|**Description**| Indicator if the container is full or empty. True = full equipment, False = empty equipment |
|**Validation**|R087 - V-for PUT duplicate check |

loading.description:
| | |
|----|----|
|**Length**| an..5 |
|**Occurrence**| 1..1 |
|**Description**| Loading or discharge. True = loading, False = discharge |
|**Validation**|R043 - V-for PUT duplicate check |
